source.sectionTitle: Advanced Cardiac Arrest Algorithm Adult and Paediatric

record.item: Advanced Cardiac Arrest Algorithm Adult and Paediatric (RMMCH)

symptoms: Unresponsive patient, not breathing or only gasping, no pulse (or pulse rate < 60 in children and infants).

management_steps.details: Compression rate 100-120 per minute. Push hard, ensure full recoil, minimize interruptions. Compression-ventilation ratio: Adult 30:2; Children/Infants 30:2 (2-rescuer 15:2). 1 breath every 6 seconds if advanced airway.

Give 1 Shock: Monophasic 360J, Biphasic 120-360J, Paediatric 4 J/kg. Immediately resume CPR for 2 minutes. Adrenaline 1mg (0.01mg/kg in paediatrics) every 3-5 min. Amiodarone 300mg followed by 150mg (5mg/kg in paediatrics) OR Lignocaine 1.5mg/kg initial, followed by 0.5mg/kg (max 3mg/kg).
Immediately resume CPR starting with compressions for 2 minutes. Administer Adrenaline as soon as vascular access obtained (1mg adults, 0.01mg/kg paediatrics every 3-5 min).

Hypoxia, Hypovolaemia, Hypothermia, Hydrogen ion (Acidosis), Hypo/Hyperkalaemia, Hypoglycaemia, Tension Pneumothorax, Tamponade (Cardiac), Toxins, Trauma, Thrombosis (Coronary), Thrombosis (Pulmonary).
